statement: Widening rs_momentum exit grid (SL6/TP18/hold20) lets momentum winners run further and lifts expectancy without proportional DD increase
verdict_note: batch4: wider exit hurt rather than helped — PF 1.01, DD 20.8% vs v1 PF 1.03, DD 12.4%. Hold extension forced unprofitable overstays. Exit grid of v1 is better.

statement: Adding VWAP-close confirmation to delivery_breakout_v3 removes intraday fade breakouts and lifts PF by 0.1+
verdict_note: batch4: VWAP gate cut trades to 117 and PF fell to 1.06 (v3 was 1.22). The filter removed winners not just losers — VWAP reclaim too restrictive on breakout days.

statement: Adding EMA50 above-price gate to high_momentum_52w_v2 restricts signals to confirmed up-legs and improves PF
verdict_note: batch4: EMA50 gate made no difference — identical results to v2 (PF 0.95, DD 18.2%). Near-52w-high stocks are inherently above EMA50 already; the gate adds zero filtering power for this signal family.

statement: Adding EMA50 alignment to bb_squeeze_breakout_v1 reduces false breakouts in downtrends and lifts PF above 0.8
verdict_note: batch4: EMA50 gate provided minimal improvement (PF 0.55 vs 0.54). BB squeeze fires indiscriminately on 1800+ trades — the fundamental problem is signal selectivity, not trend direction. Spec family needs redesign, not patching.

statement: Asymmetric exit (SL4/TP14/hold12, R:R=3.5) on delivery_breakout_v3 raises expectancy and PF by letting confirmed breakouts reach a farther target
verdict_note: batch4: PROMOTED. PF 1.34, expectancy 1.04%/trade, DD 9.08% over 140 trades. Beats v3 on every dimension: PF up 0.12, expectancy up 50%, DD down 2.3%. Tighter stop + wider target is the right R:R for delivery-confirmed breakouts.

statement: Tightening delivery_breakout_v5 stop to 3% (SL3/TP14) reduces DD below 9% while maintaining PF 1.34
verdict_note: batch5: PROMOTED. PF 1.34 (identical to v5), DD drops to 8.47% (vs 9.08%), Sharpe 0.64 (vs 0.61). SL3 clips the shallow losses without cutting winners — delivery-confirmed breakouts rarely recover after a 3% drawdown. v6 is now co-top spec with v5.

statement: Widening delivery_breakout_v5 target to 18%/hold15 lets breakouts sustain a larger move and raises expectancy above 1.5%
verdict_note: batch5: PF fell to 1.17, exp 0.576% (v5 was 1.34/1.038%). Wider target means fewer hits in a bear/sideways market — most breakouts reverse before reaching 18%. 14% is closer to the modal post-entry move. v5 exit grid remains best.

statement: Tightening rs_momentum_v1 stop to 3% reduces DD from 12.4% and lifts PF above 1.1
verdict_note: batch5: PF fell to 0.93, DD actually rose to 16.0%. SL3 cuts near-52w-high entries too early — these stocks have natural volatility of 3-5% intraday; a 3% stop is hit by noise before the move develops. SL5 is the right floor for this family.

statement: Relaxing rs_momentum rs_floor from 0.90 to 0.80 adds 90 trades from the 2nd RS decile while maintaining edge
verdict_note: batch5: PF 1.05, exp 0.152%, 306 trades, DD 14.1%. Marginal improvement over v1 — the 80th-90th percentile adds volume but dilutes edge slightly vs. the pure top decile. Useful if trade count is the constraint; otherwise v1/v3 are cleaner.

statement: Widening rs_momentum exit to TP15/hold15 lets high-RS momentum names run further
verdict_note: batch5: PF 1.02, exp 0.077% — marginally worse than v1 (1.03/0.112%). Wider target/hold only extends losing overstays; top-decile RS names do not sustain 15%+ moves in a flat market. 10% target is the right horizon.

statement: Tightening high_momentum_52w_v2 stop to 3% flips PF above 1.0 by cutting shallow drawdowns on the 355-trade sample
verdict_note: batch5: PF 0.88 (worse than v2's 0.95), DD 19.6%. Tight stop on near-52w-high entries increases false stops — these names regularly dip 3-4% intraday before continuing. Family is unprofitable regardless of SL; root cause is signal quality, not exit tuning.

statement: Combining double delivery+volume confirm (v3 entry) with RS >= 0.70 gate and asymmetric exit (SL4/TP14) produces PF > 1.3
verdict_note: batch5: PF 1.22, exp 0.689%, DD 15.4% over only 88 trades — below the 100-trade floor. Signal quality is strong (second-best PF after delivery_breakout_v5/v6) but too selective. Try relaxing RS floor to 0.60 or removing it to get trades > 100, then retest.

statement: Tightening rs_delivery_breakout_v1 stop to 3% reduces its 22.9% DD below 15%
verdict_note: batch5: PF 1.10, exp 0.306%, DD 19.6% — DD barely moved despite SL tightening. The 22.9% DD in v1 comes from a run of consecutive losses, not individual trade size. Fix requires a consecutive-loss cool-off or a regime gate, not a tighter stop.

statement: EMA20 pullback-bounce entry in EMA50 uptrend with delivery confirm (Grimes Ch.3/6) generates selective, high-quality trades (PF > 1.2, < 500 trades)
verdict_note: batch5: 5580 trades, PF 0.70, DD 365%. The touch_tolerance=1.01 gate (prev_close <= 1.01 * ema20_prev) is still too loose across 1800 symbols. Needs either: (a) require low (not close) to touch EMA20, or (b) add a minimum pullback depth (>2% from recent high). File as new spec refinement.

statement: Adding RSI > 50 momentum gate to bb_squeeze_breakout_v2 reduces false squeezes firing into exhausted moves
verdict_note: batch5: Identical results to v2 (PF 0.55, 1853 trades) — RSI > 50 filtered zero additional trades, meaning all squeeze-breakout candidates already have RSI > 50 at that point. The BB squeeze family fires on too many low-quality setups to be patched with gates; needs full redesign (true Keltner containment).

statement: News-sentiment + order-win event features lift validation AUC by >= 0.02 over the core feature set (else the news/order-win adapters stay off)
verdict_note: Adapter BUILT (src/predictor/adapters/{news_adapter,sentiment_words}.py): Google News RSS, recency-weighted keyword sentiment + first-class order-win event class, graceful-degrade, telemetry. Wired as LIVE enrichment of the daily watchlist only (data-cost rule: fetch candidates, not 1761) -> sentiment chip + order-win badge + headline on predictor.html; dated news panel stored to data/features/news/<asof>.parquet. TRAINING ABLATION BLOCKED: Google News RSS returns only ~recent items (~1mo), so there is no point-in-time historical news to backfill the 12mo training panel - the feature is all-NaN over training history and cannot be ablated yet. Resolution: accrue news forward (run predict_daily daily); re-open the ablation once >= ~3mo of dated news history exists. Live enrichment value delivered now; AUC/PF lift unproven until history accumulates.

Sweeping the swing label horizon H in {5,10,15} and TP/SL multiples finds a barrier set raising validation expectancy by >= 0.1% vs the config default (SL5/TP10/H10)
verdict_note: scripts/sweep_labels.py over 18 barrier sets. Winner SL5/TP14/H15 beats default SL5/TP10/H10 on expectancy by +0.39% (2-fold recent window: exp +0.946% PF 1.34 vs +0.553% PF 1.22) AND +0.19% across all 4 folds (exp -0.009% PF 1.05 vs -0.203% PF 0.97) - robust to the weak early-2026 regimes. Clear monotone effect: longer horizon (H15>H10) + wider target (TP14) lift expectancy; default was cutting winners short. AUC inverts (short H5 highest AUC, worst economics) - economic test rightly outranks AUC. RECOMMENDATION for human: adopt TARGET_PCT=14, MAX_HOLD_DAYS=15 in config.py (risk-cap change = human ratification per safety rails), then retrain. Not auto-applied.
